orientations.intent: Determine whether a remote workforce calendar can be queried through the available tools.

final_message: No — the available tools (repo, tests, git, episodes) only expose code repository operations (status, tests, git actions, episode logs). There is no tool or endpoint for querying a remote workforce/HR calendar system, so that data cannot be retrieved through the tools currently available to me.

files.content: Roster windows are repository-local and do not contact a calendar service.
